i.norm: Verifies that {@link MutableClock#add(java.time.temporal.TemporalAmount)} is thread-safe: when many threads each add a fixed amount concurrently, no update is lost, so the final instant equals the sum of every individual increment.
Each task advances the shared clock by the same fixed amount.
Run the same update many times across a pool sized to oversubscribe the CPU, maximising the chance of exposing a lost-update race.
If every increment was applied atomically, the clock advanced by the full sum of all increments from the epoch.
